summary: Samantha Android voice delegates every turn to Samantha's brain: Gemini Live keeps identity and speaking style only, the voice decision is always evidence-required outside deterministic routes, and turns the dialogue coordinator leaves unresolved go to the main agent through the existing ask_samantha owner.

routes.change: coordinator-unresolved turns are delegated to the main agent (submitIntent voiceDelegation) with a 30 s bounded read
routes.budget: 30 s brain wait, inside the app 45 s read timeout

capability_impact.detail: No capability added or changed; deterministic voice routes are untouched. The voice surface routes non-deterministic turns to the existing main-agent owner.

architecture_impact.reason: Role of Gemini Live narrowed to voice I/O; unresolved voice turns routed to the existing main agent instead of a second Graph execution. No new service, store, router, scheduler or retry.

mcp_parity.detail: No MCP tool or adapter change.

rollback: Revert this commit and redeploy the Companion with companion-deploy.sh; no app change.
